mapper.select: select * from agent_key_file.report_batch where id = #{batchId} for update
select count(1) from agent_key_file.report_task where batch_id = #{batchId} and status in ('QUEUED', 'PROCESSING')
mapper.update: update agent_key_file.report_task set status = 'PROCESSING', progress_percent = 10, started_time = coalesce(started_time, #{startedTime}), lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, update_by = #{username}, update_time = #{startedTime} where id = #{taskId} and status = 'QUEUED'
update agent_key_file.report_task set update_time = update_time where id = #{taskId} and status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}

update agent_key_file.report_task set status = #{record.status}, progress_percent = #{record.progressPercent}, result_summary = #{record.resultSummary}, error_message = #{record.errorMessage}, started_time = #{record.startedTime}, ended_time = #{record.endedTime}, duration_ms = #{record.durationMs}, update_by = #{record.updateBy}, update_time = #{record.updateTime}, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null where id = #{record.id} and status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}

update agent_key_file.report_batch set status = #{record.status}, current_stage = #{record.currentStage}, progress_percent = #{record.progressPercent}, success_row_count = #{record.successRowCount}, error_row_count = #{record.errorRowCount}, process_call_status = #{record.processCallStatus}, result_summary = #{record.resultSummary}, error_summary = #{record.errorSummary}, update_by = #{record.updateBy}, update_time = #{record.updateTime} where id = #{record.id} and del_flag = 0

update agent_key_file.report_task t set status = 'QUEUED', progress_percent = 0, started_time = null, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, error_message = '执行实例租约失效，已自动恢复排队', update_time = current_timestamp where t.status = 'PROCESSING' and t.task_type in ('PARSE', 'LOAD') and t.lease_until < #{now} and exists (select 1 from agent_key_file.report_batch b where b.id = t.batch_id and b.del_flag = 0)

update agent_key_file.report_task set status = 'FAILED', progress_percent = 100, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, error_message = '加工执行实例租约失效；为避免重复调用存储过程，需核对 ETL 状态后手工重试', ended_time = current_timestamp, update_time = current_timestamp where status = 'PROCESSING' and task_type = 'PROCESS' and lease_until < #{now}

update agent_key_file.report_batch b set status = 'FAILED', current_stage = 'PROCESS', process_call_status = 'FAILED', error_summary = 'PROCESS 租约失效；请先核对 ETL 日志状态再重试', update_time = current_timestamp where b.del_flag = 0 and b.status = 'PROCESSING' and exists (select 1 from agent_key_file.report_task t where t.batch_id = b.id and t.task_type = 'PROCESS' and t.status = 'FAILED' and t.error_message like '加工执行实例租约失效%')

update agent_key_file.report_process_call set status = 'FAILED', error_message = '进程中断或超时，已释放内部互斥状态', ended_time = current_timestamp where status in ('QUEUED', 'PROCESSING') and started_time < #{cutoff}
mapper.select: select t.* from agent_key_file.report_task t join agent_key_file.report_batch b on b.id = t.batch_id and b.del_flag = 0 where t.status = 'QUEUED' order by t.create_time limit #{limit}
select * from agent_key_file.report_file where batch_id = #{batchId} and del_flag = 0 order by create_time, original_name
select count(1) from etl.guoku_lib_report_all_log where state = '1'
select count(1) from agent_key_file.report_process_call where status in ('QUEUED', 'PROCESSING')
select coalesce(max(attempt_no), 0) + 1 from agent_key_file.report_process_call where batch_id = #{batchId}
